svg.title: PC.1 One OR between centres
svg.text: Provinces, places: DARE · roads: Itiner-e (CC BY 4.0) · coast, rivers: Natural Earth · kiln sites: Samian Research
OR: one centre or the other, so the weight is shared
Samian Research: carrier 202335 of Saciro iv, centre string “Pfaffenhofen or Westerndorf”
(Raetian tradition); the same string as in chain B.
